patterns.name: Coronal knee splay
patterns.cause: A garment-width hip estimate can place hips outside the measured leg columns.
patterns.math: hip_knee_ratio = abs(hip_x)/abs(knee_x); coronal_offset = knee_x - lerp(hip_x, ankle_x, height_fraction).
patterns.provisional_rule: Ratio > 1.18, or inward offset > 8 mm and > 0.22 knee radii.
patterns.repair: Fit hips from observed leg columns; attenuate lateral IK poles near extension.
patterns.limit: Hip-normalized gait width can hide an inflated hip estimate; also normalize by leg length.

patterns.name: Off-centre knee pivot
patterns.cause: A pivot displaced from the limb section causes asymmetric travel and collapse.
patterns.math: Intersect 24 rays in the bisecting joint plane; divide centroid-to-joint offset by mean radius.
patterns.provisional_rule: Pivot offset > 0.30 radii or flexed section radius < 0.55 rest radius.
patterns.repair: Recenter the joint from the local surface; verify child compensation and deformed volume.
patterns.limit: Open/concave surfaces and invalid fans need unavailable results, not guessed radii.

patterns.name: Tiptoe bind and misplaced ball joint
patterns.cause: Aligning a downward ankle-to-toe bind bone to a horizontal vector rotates the sole; a toe-tip pivot cannot roll the forefoot.
patterns.math: ball_station = (ball_forward - heel_forward)/(tip_forward - heel_forward); heel lift follows lever*sin(pitch).
patterns.provisional_rule: Missing toe joint or ball station outside 0.45–0.85 shoe length.
patterns.repair: Preserve the bind sole frame and measure an anatomical ball pivot.
patterns.limit: Oversized or stylized footwear requires measured support, not a universal shoe percentage.

patterns.name: Sleeve weight contamination
patterns.cause: Sleeve vertices weighted to pelvis or legs stretch into a web during arm swing.
patterns.math: Count lower-arm vertices with >=0.10 arm share and >=0.05 lower-body share; inspect FK edge stretch.
patterns.provisional_rule: Any such bleed, max bleed >=0.12, p99 edge stretch >2.2, or invalid elbow fan.
patterns.repair: Constrain diffusion by anatomical branches; inspect seams and shoulder transition.
patterns.limit: Edge stretch alone is not visual silhouette approval; fused surfaces can make partitions uncertain.

patterns.name: Hand clearance starvation
patterns.cause: A wide garment consumes the rest arm corridor and the hand intersects it in a sagittal swing.
patterns.math: Coronal margin and static hand-surface distance versus declared garment geometry.
patterns.provisional_rule: Rest margin <5 mm, minimum swing clearance <6 mm, or penetration hits.
patterns.repair: Adjust measured arm corridor while preserving reach and retest sleeve deformation.
patterns.limit: Open shells cannot certify volume penetration; small bodies need scale-aware calibration.

patterns.name: Missing hair response
patterns.cause: Hair without dynamic chains or sufficient dynamic skin influence cannot respond independently.
patterns.math: Count spring-like hair bones and dynamic hair weight share.
patterns.provisional_rule: No spring bones or dynamic share <0.05.
patterns.repair: Declare hair topology and attachment roots; solve against body colliders.
patterns.limit: Bone names alone do not prove simulation or collision; rigid hairstyles may intentionally have no secondary motion.

patterns.name: Fused hip-fold intersection
patterns.cause: A single fused garment/body mesh folds into itself during deep hip flexion.
patterns.math: Count nonadjacent triangle overlaps near the hip in rest and 90-degree flexion.
patterns.provisional_rule: Single fused mesh and intersection-count increase >350.
patterns.repair: Separate meaningful surfaces and complete hidden body geometry before binding.
patterns.limit: Counts depend on tessellation and cannot be universal physical thresholds.

patterns.name: Pelvis reach and oversized sole lever
patterns.cause: Straight leg reach clamping and large shoe pitch corrections can pump the pelvis.
patterns.provisional_rule: Slack <0.0085 with lever >0.48, or slack <0.005 with lever >0.35.
patterns.repair: Plan a smooth feasible root curve with explicit reach and contact constraints.
patterns.limit: Static geometry predicts risk only; inspect actual native soles and pelvis trajectories.
